campaign_proposal.baseline_manifest:
version: 1
kind: interface_manifest
project_id: group_run
source_prd: "PRD group_run v0.5 (SIP-0098 §6.7)"
stack: fullstack_fastapi_react
scope: "Full-stack MVP for creating, listing, viewing, joining, and leaving group run events with in-memory storage; excludes authentication, persistent storage, capacity enforcement, and datetime parsing"
entities:
  - name: Run
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string, required: true, generated: true }
      - { name: title, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: datetime, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: meeting_location, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: distance, type: string, required: false, default: null }
      - { name: pace_target, type: string, required: false, default: null }
      - { name: route_notes, type: string, required: false, default: null }
      - { name: participants, type: "list[string]", required: true, default: [] }
  - name: RunListItem
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: title, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: datetime, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: meeting_location, type: string, required: true }
      - { name: distance, type: string, required: false, default: null }
      - { name: participant_count, type: integer, required: true }
api:
  base_path: /api
  request_shapes:
    RunCreate:
      required: [title, datetime, meeting_location]
      optional: [distance, pace_target, route_notes]
    ParticipantAction:
      required: [name]
  endpoints:
    - method: POST
      path: /runs
      summary: create a run event
      request: RunCreate
      response: Run
      success_status: 201
      errors: [validation_error]
    - method: GET
      path: /runs
      summary: list all runs with participant counts
      response: "list[RunListItem]"
    - method: GET
      path: /runs/{run_id}
      summary: get run details and participant list
      response: Run
      errors: [run_not_found]
    - method: POST
      path: /runs/{run_id}/join
      summary: join a run by participant name
      request: ParticipantAction
      response: Run
      errors: [run_not_found, duplicate_participant, validation_error]
    - method: POST
      path: /runs/{run_id}/leave
      summary: leave a run by participant name
      request: ParticipantAction
      response: Run
      errors: [run_not_found, participant_not_found, validation_error]
  error_contract:
    codes:
      validation_error: { http: 422 }
      run_not_found: { http: 404 }
      duplicate_participant: { http: 409 }
      participant_not_found: { http: 404 }
frontend:
  framework: react_vite
  routes:
    - path: /
      view: RunListView
      purpose: display all runs with participant counts and a link to create a new run
      testids: [run-list-view, run-list, run-row, create-run-link]
    - path: /runs/new
      view: CreateRunView
      purpose: form to create a new run event with required and optional fields
      testids: [create-run-view, create-run-form, create-run-title, create-run-datetime, create-run-location, create-run-submit, create-run-error]
    - path: /runs/:run_id
      view: RunDetailView
      purpose: view run details, participant list, and join/leave forms
      testids: [run-detail-view, run-detail-title, participant-list, participant-name, join-form, join-name, join-submit, leave-form, leave-name, leave-submit, run-error]
persistence: in_memory
decisions:
  - id: duplicate-name-case-sensitivity
    choice: "Duplicate participant name check is case-insensitive; 'Alice' and 'alice' are treated as the same participant on the same run"
    warrant: "PRD §5.4 — 'case sensitivity behavior should be defined in implementation; default recommendation: case-insensitive uniqueness'"
  - id: leave-unknown-participant
    choice: "Leaving with a name not on the run returns HTTP 404 with a descriptive message, not a silent 200 no-op"
    warrant: "PRD §5.5 — 'choose one and document in QA handoff'; 404 chosen for explicit error signaling the UI can render"
  - id: join-leave-response-shape
    choice: "POST /runs/{run_id}/join and POST /runs/{run_id}/leave both return the full updated Run entity identical in shape to GET /runs/{run_id}"
    warrant: "PRD §5.4–5.5 require the participant list and count to update immediately; returning the full run lets the UI re-render without a second fetch"
  - id: list-projection
    choice: "GET /runs returns RunListItem (title, datetime, meeting_location, distance, participant_count) — not pace_target, route_notes, or the full participant array"
    warrant: "PRD §5.2 lists minimum fields for the list: title, date/time, meeting location, participant count"
  - id: datetime-format
    unresolved: true
    question: "PRD §5.1 requires a date/time field as string input but does not specify a format (ISO 8601, free-text, datepicker value); the backend stores and echoes the string verbatim — is a canonical format expected, or is free-form acceptable for MVP?"

provenance:

  attempts: 1
  revisions: []

objective.statement: evolve group_run toward its PRD's expansion scope, one increment at a time

gate_decisions.notes: Ruled as the shakeout's delegated supervisor (uncounted, 2.0 charter). Approved: a feature in scope toward the PRD's Expansion Tier 1 (capacity limit per run). T1 (POST /runs echoes capacity), T2 (join at capacity -> 409 capacity_reached) and T3 (run-capacity shows count / capacity) each fail on the baseline for a behavioural reason. Footprint: five product files plus test dirs; manifest delta additive; no frozen criteria yet, no retirements.

Campaign shakeout cmp_3cd057058851 increment 1 (uncounted). Approved under the 2.0 regression set's gate policy: system plan validation passed; no additional judgment applied. The open design question (datetime-format) is inherited from the accepted manifest and answered as at the calibration's gate: stored and echoed verbatim.
